units.text: EXT. WHALEBONE TOLL BRIDGE - DUSK
A bridge made from the ribs of a dead sea-beast arches over a grey gorge.
A tin lantern hangs at the midpoint.
BRANNOCH, fifties, broad, in a patched toll-keeper's coat, sits on a stool beside a rope barrier.
He counts copper coins into a bowl.
A STRANGER in a travel-stained cloak walks up from the east road.
Hood up.
A staff in one hand.
Toll is two coppers. Four if you've a cart.
units.name: BRANNOCH

units.text: No cart.
units.name: STRANGER

units.text: Brannoch holds out a hand.
The Stranger drops two coins in it.
Brannoch bites one.
Good. Name for the ledger?
units.name: BRANNOCH

units.text: Do I need one?
units.name: STRANGER

units.text: Ledger likes a name. Keeps the dead from being counted twice.
units.name: BRANNOCH

units.text: The Stranger thinks.
Pushes the hood back.
A young woman, weathered, a scar through one eyebrow.
Tavi.
units.name: STRANGER

units.text: Brannoch writes it in a thick book.
Tavi. Where to?
units.name: BRANNOCH

units.text: Over. Then the salt towns.
units.name: TAVI

units.text: Brannoch! The rope's slipped again!
units.name: ILSEWYN

units.text: Brannoch sighs and leans over the rail.
Hold it, then! I'm busy!
units.name: BRANNOCH

units.text: I am holding it! It's holding me!
units.name: ILSEWYN

units.text: My sister. She keeps the ferry cables.
units.name: BRANNOCH

units.text: She sounds tired.
units.name: TAVI

units.text: I am! And I can hear you!
units.name: ILSEWYN

units.text: She's been tired since our mother died.
units.name: BRANNOCH

units.text: Brannoch lifts the rope barrier.
Tavi steps toward the span, then stops.
Is it true the ribs sing at night?
units.name: TAVI

units.text: When the wind comes from the north.
units.name: BRANNOCH

units.text: It does not sing, Brannoch, it whistles.
units.name: ILSEWYN

units.text: It sings, and always has.
units.name: BRANNOCH

units.text: It whistles, and always has.
units.name: ILSEWYN

units.text: Tavi looks from one to the other, almost smiling.
Then I'll listen on the way across.
units.name: TAVI

units.text: She walks onto the bridge.
Brannoch watches her go, then sits and takes up the coins again.
Mind the third rib. It's loose.
units.name: BRANNOCH
